info.title: Kraken API
info.description: Critical-path API implemented in the first development slices. Draft editing, local users/admin-manager roles with manager scope, separate proxy accounts, bounded event history and retained 24-hour statistics are implemented. Listener ports are installation settings and cannot change via draft/revision operations. Draft preview is read-only. Errors include 400 invalid input, 401 unauthenticated, 403 CSRF/authorization (admin_required, policy_shared_out_of_scope, draft_out_of_scope), 404 unknown resource (or out-of-scope object), 409 conflict/busy (username_taken), 422 policy/capability failure (source_outside_scope, source_overlap, not_manager), 429 throttled, 503 unavailable. All responses containing session/config data use Cache-Control: no-store. Origin is checked on mutations in addition to CSRF. Visual settings and guarded expert mode, general clients, revision history/diff and rollback are supported. Password reset is local CLI only, never a public recovery endpoint. Panel roles are admin (all) and manager (scoped to assigned clients and networks; can edit draft within scope, validate/apply own changes, manage own proxy logins). Proxy Basic accounts are separate; managed helper, TLS-only authenticated clients, exact username+IP policy matching. In-binary help articles are exposed via read-only index and article endpoints.

post.description: Creates a durable SQLite operation intent before the in-process worker runs. 409 for conflicting key/revision; busy is explicit. Apply requires validated exact inputs. Rollback uses the local Squid adapter and is verified. No separate runner or Docker API. Admin-only; manager receives 403 admin_required. Revision operations cannot change installation-owned HTTP/TLS listeners, including rollback to old revisions.

get.description: Admin-only. Exact actor/action/entity_id filters, stable earlier-page cursor (fingerprint includes every filter). Retention 90 days and 5000 rows. get.summary: Live Squid aggregate metrics (admin/manager)
get.description: Bounded fixed loopback manager reports only. Last successful sample is retained in memory on failure, marked unavailable/stale with original observed_at. Unsupported or unmeasured values are null. No raw URLs, usernames or manager reports. Five-minute metrics are null until Squid has a sampling interval. Origin traffic and request rate exclude manager polling and cache hits. Old active configs require a separate service configuration update; GET never applies drafts.

get.summary: Recent sources and grouped access problems

503.description: Storage busy or request deadline exceeded; retry the same request. code=storage_busy, Retry-After: 2.

get.description: Admin/manager read-only operational view over retained completed access-log events in [from,to). minutes=15, 60 (default), 1440 (day), 10080 (week) or 43200 (rolling 30 days). Sources grouped by IP and proxy username; issues additionally by sanitized destination and exact Squid result. Denied means DENIED; errors count other >=400/FAIL/ABORTED results. At most 10 rows per group, sorted by frequency; totals expose omissions. No inference of client availability, matched ACL or live tunnel contents. Applied policy counts come from confirmed runtime manifest, never draft. Ingestion exposes public quality fields only. 503 on storage error.

scope.description: Manager scope (networks and client_ids); null/absent for admin.

kind.description: Client metadata; not tied to virtualization.

proxy_username.description: Optional dedicated proxy account. Requires TLS transport. Source IP/CIDR AND exact username select policy; distinct usernames may share ranges. No password in snapshot.

expert_config.description: User squid.conf section. Managed runtime directives, includes and executable helpers prohibited; validate with real Squid before apply.

number.description: Sequential revision number shown as r-<number>; assigned with the revision and never reused after pruning

summary.description: User changes only. Empty when effective user settings match, including runtime-only updates.

config_diff.description: Bounded unified line diff with three context lines and hunk headers. Generated fingerprint values are normalized; compiler and directive changes remain visible. At most 400 lines; explicit omission message for excessive comparisons. Full unmodified text is in generated_config.

user_changes.description: Effective user configuration differs from the applied snapshot, after expanding omitted defaults and normalizing set-like values.

runtime_changes.description: The installed compiler/runtime options render the applied snapshot differently from the currently running managed configuration. This is a separate update, not a user setting change.

status.description: Statuses actually emitted by the server: pending (intent persisted, worker not started), validating/validated (standalone Validate operation), reloading (Apply worker staging/reloading), succeeded/rejected/rolled_back/degraded (terminal). The DRAFT value used by listRevisions COALESCE for revisions without any operation is exposed via RevisionSummary.latest_status, not here. Internal Journal stages (staged/promoting/reloading/rolling_back/terminal/first_run/initialised) remain in the durable journal but are not surfaced as public Operation.status.

applied_revision_number.description: Number of the applied revision; null when nothing is applied

runtime.description: Internal management module health, not a remote runner.

has_unapplied_changes.description: Effective user changes only; omitted defaults, nil/empty lists and ordering of set-like ACL values do not create pending changes.

runtime_update_available.description: Managed configuration update is available independently of user changes; null when current runtime/draft cannot be read.

id.description: Opaque event id in compact <YYYYMM>-<rowid> form: the month key plus the rowid within events-YYYY-MM.db.

count.description: Number of identical requests coalesced into this record.

client_name.description: Source label stored at ingestion; later edits do not rewrite it.

client_match_basis.description: Unique source IP/CIDR match at ingestion, not historical ACL proof.

proxy_username.description: Sanitized logged proxy username, not proof of successful authentication. No password.

gap.description: Known reader loss/malformed records, or older history removed by retention. More pages are indicated by next_cursor separately.

name.description: Client name from the active snapshot; null for unmatched sources or clients no longer in the snapshot.

histogram.description: Exactly ceil((to-from)/step) buckets spanning [from, to), oldest first; empty buckets are zero.

http_port.description: Installation-owned listener. The API retains existing installed values and rejects draft updates and operations that change this port with 422 installation_setting. It is not a web-editable setting.

tls_port.description: Installation-owned listener. The API retains existing installed values and rejects draft updates and operations that change this port with 422 installation_setting. It is not a web-editable setting.

maximum_object_kb.description: Server-side validator additionally requires maximum_object_kb ≤ cache_memory_mb * 1024, so the effective ceiling scales with the configured cache. The absolute maximum 1048576 (1 GiB) is reachable only when cache_memory_mb is at its own ceiling of 1024.

blocked_domains.description: Domains denied for every client before user policy applies. Rendered ahead of # BEGIN user policy so it binds in both structured and expert modes.

hide_client_address.description: When true, strips the client address from forwarded requests via forwarded_for delete and via off.

state.description: Event collection loop state: ok (ingesting), storage_low (paused below the low-disk threshold), error (last collection failed).

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last state observation.

owner.description: Panel username owning the login, or null for admin.

password.description: 12–1024 UTF-8 bytes; never returned or persisted as plaintext. Proxy passwords cannot contain NUL/CR/LF.

Statistics.description: Retained completed access-log records by event timestamp over [from,to), rolling 24 hours. Denied means Squid DENIED result, not arbitrary origin HTTP403. bytes_observed is logged bytes only; not bandwidth or active tunnel traffic. observed_at is calculation time; ingestion freshness comes from events response. retention_limited marks the 50000-row retention cap.

active_requests.description: Active request URI records excluding fixed manager/canary requests and idle socket blocks. Includes open CONNECT tunnels. Manager identity uses reported local socket and fixed path; Squid may rewrite URI authority to its first listener.

memory_peak_bytes.description: Maximum Resident Size reported by Squid; peak RSS, not current memory.

cache_hit_ratio_percent.description: Squid reported info 5min ratio; includes diagnostic requests.

origin_requests_per_second.description: 5min server.all.requests rate, excludes diagnostics and cache hits.

cache_enabled.description: Effective setting from confirmed active LKG snapshot; null if unavailable or drifted.

UpstreamProxy.description: Parent proxy for outbound traffic. IP literal outside protected ranges; private addresses are allowed.

exclusive.description: true: never_direct allow all; false: direct fallback

HelpEntry.description: One row of the embedded help index. The section sequence and per-article order are fixed at build time from front matter.

slug.description: Matches the article file stem; used as the path parameter and help: link target.

screen.description: UI section the article describes ("Открыть в интерфейсе"); absent for conceptual articles.

HelpArticle.description: A help entry plus its markdown body. Inter-article references use [text](help:slug) links resolved by docs-check.

networks.description: CIDR networks assigned to the manager.

client_ids.description: Client IDs assigned to the manager.

data_free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the data volume (statfs of the SQLite directory); null on error.

data_total_bytes.description: Total bytes on the data volume; null on error.

journal_last_event_at.description: Timestamp of the most recently ingested retained event; null when none.

journal_checkpoint_at.description: Observed-at of the last committed event checkpoint; null when none.

last_applied_at.description: Updated-at of the most recent succeeded apply operation; null when none.

telemetry_bytes.description: Total size in bytes of telemetry files (monthly events DBs with WAL/SHM and rollups.db); null before telemetry is opened.

events_oldest_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the oldest retained raw event; null when none.

telemetry_broken_files.description: Number of telemetry files quarantined as broken by this process.

Instance.description: Instance identity, data-volume free space, telemetry size and event-journal freshness.

InspectorSeriesBucket.description: One 15-minute bucket of the client 24h series.

host.description: Bare destination hostname; port, userinfo and path are stripped.

denied.description: Count by the SaveEvents failed rule, not origin 403.

series.description: Exactly 96 15-minute buckets, oldest first; the last bucket holds the current moment.

open_connections.description: Active request count from Squid metrics; null when unavailable.

top_destinations.description: Up to 10 hosts by request count descending.

domains.description: Every domain of the policy (draft, else active), including those without hits.

InspectorExplain.description: Re-evaluation of a completed request against the active policy. No URL path/query, credentials or Squid output.

InspectorDraftImpact.description: Each retained 24h event is evaluated against the active policy and the draft; only divergences are counted.
